journey.name: contact reselect after back
journey.description: After a contact payment opens from Send, going back to the contact list lets the same or another contact be picked again in the same Send visit, and the new payment starts with an empty amount. Requires an onboarded regtest wallet with funds in Savings, Paykit UI enabled, a Pubky profile and two saved contacts that publish public payment details (staging: "Contact Paykit #1" and "Contact Paykit #2" from bitkit-e2e-tests `STAGING_PAYKIT_CONTACTS`). Contact rows have ids "SendContact-<pubky>". No payment is sent: close the sheet from the amount screen.

actions.action: Tap the first contact's row and verify the send amount screen (id "SendAmount") opens
Enter 1 000 on the number pad and verify the amount field (id "SendNumberField") shows it
Tap Back (id "NavigationBack") and verify the contact list shows both rows, enabled and without a loading indicator
Tap the first contact's row again and verify the send amount screen (id "SendAmount") opens with an empty amount
Tap Back (id "NavigationBack"), tap the second contact's row and verify the send amount screen (id "SendAmount") opens with an empty amount and the second contact's avatar in the header
Tap Back (id "NavigationBack") twice and verify the Send options (id "RecipientContact") are visible
Choose Contact, tap the first contact's row and verify the send amount screen (id "SendAmount") opens
Close the Send sheet without paying, open Send again and verify the Send options are visible
